## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` is green locally (`typecheck` + tests)

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data or machine-specific absolute paths added
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant (README, `docs/`, examples)
- [ ] Commits are conventional and atomic (one logical change per commit)
- [ ] CI is expected green on Node 24.x
